value.zh-CN: 当前选中的值，可 `bind:value`。单选为单个值，多选为数组，开启 `onChangeWithObject` 时为选项对象。不传时由组件自行管理；单向 `value={x}` 只作初值，要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:value={get, set}`；绑成 `undefined` 会清空选中。没有 defaultValue。
value.en-US: The selected value, supports `bind:value`. A single value in single mode, an array in multiple mode, and option objects with `onChangeWithObject`. Left out, the component manages it; a one-way `value={x}` only seeds it, and for a fully controlled Select use the function binding `bind:value={get, set}`. Binding it to `undefined` clears the selection. There is no defaultValue.

multiple.en-US: Whether multiple options can be selected.

optionList.zh-CN: 选项数据，条目含 `value`、`label`、`disabled`、`showTick`、`class`、`style` 以及可选的 `group: { key, label }`，其他字段随选项记录回传。同一分组的条目必须相邻。
optionList.en-US: The option data. An entry has `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `showTick`, `class`, `style` and an optional `group: { key, label }`; other fields travel with the option record. Entries of one group must be adjacent.

filter.zh-CN: 是否开启搜索。传 true 时用输入值与选项 label 或分组标题做 include 对比（不区分大小写），传函数时自定义匹配。
filter.en-US: Whether to enable search. true compares the input case-insensitively with the option label or the group title; a function customizes the match.

remote.zh-CN: 是否为远程搜索，开启后不再在本地筛选选项，由使用方更新 `optionList`。
remote.en-US: Whether the search is remote. When on, the options are not filtered locally and the caller updates `optionList`.

allowCreate.zh-CN: 是否允许创建列表中不存在的选项，需配合 `filter`。
allowCreate.en-US: Whether options that are not in the list can be created; use it with `filter`.

autoClearSearchValue.zh-CN: 多选选中后是否自动清空搜索关键字。
autoClearSearchValue.en-US: Whether the search keyword is cleared after an option is selected in multiple mode.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 挂载后是否展开下拉列表。Select 没有受控的展开状态。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown list opens on mount. Select has no controlled open state.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 多选时点击选项后是否关闭下拉列表。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether the dropdown list closes after an option is clicked in multiple mode.

defaultActiveFirstOption.zh-CN: 是否默认高亮第一个可用选项。
defaultActiveFirstOption.en-US: Whether the first enabled option is highlighted by default.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: `onChange` 与 `value` 是否使用选项对象而不是选项的值。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: Whether `onChange` and `value` carry option objects instead of option values.

max.zh-CN: 多选时最多可选的数量，超出时触发 `onExceed`。
max.en-US: Maximum number of selected options in multiple mode; `onExceed` fires beyond it.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 多选时标签的最大展示数量，超出后以 +N 形式展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: Maximum number of tags shown in multiple mode; the rest are shown as +N.

maxHeight.en-US: Maximum height of the dropdown list.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超过 `maxTagCount` 后，hover 到 +N 时是否通过 Popover 显示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover once `maxTagCount` is exceeded.

expandRestTagsOnClick.zh-CN: 设置 `maxTagCount` 时，打开下拉列表后是否展开被折叠的标签。
expandRestTagsOnClick.en-US: With `maxTagCount`, whether the collapsed tags expand while the dropdown list is open.

ellipsisTrigger.zh-CN: 是否对溢出的标签做自适应处理，宽度不足时最后一个标签内容截断。有一定性能损耗，不推荐在大表单场景使用。
ellipsisTrigger.en-US: Whether overflowing tags adapt: when the width is short the last tag is truncated. It has a performance cost and is not recommended in large forms.

borderless.en-US: Whether the trigger has no border.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 `default`、`warning`、`error`，只影响背景颜色等样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: `default`, `warning` or `error`; it only affects styles such as the background color.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索框在下拉列表中时（`searchPosition="dropdown"`）搜索框的占位文字。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search input when it is in the dropdown list (`searchPosition="dropdown"`).

searchPosition.en-US: Where the search input sits: `trigger` or `dropdown`.

loading.zh-CN: 是否加载中，加载中时下拉列表显示加载状态而不是选项。
loading.en-US: Whether the options are loading; the dropdown list shows a spinner instead of the options.

showArrow.zh-CN: 是否显示右侧下拉箭头。
showArrow.en-US: Whether to show the dropdown arrow.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: 内嵌标签容器的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用；未传时在渲染 `insetLabel` 时由组件生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the inset label container, for aria-labelledby; when left out and `insetLabel` is rendered, one is generated.

inputProps.zh-CN: 搜索框 Input 的额外属性，`class` 与 `style` 落在 Input 外层。
inputProps.en-US: Extra props of the search Input; `class` and `style` land on the Input wrapper.

dropdownClassName.en-US: Class name of the dropdown layer.

dropdownStyle.en-US: Style of the dropdown layer, a string.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉层的最小宽度是否跟随触发器宽度。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown layer follows the trigger width.

position.zh-CN: 下拉层相对触发器的方位。
position.en-US: Placement of the dropdown layer relative to the trigger.

spacing.zh-CN: 下拉层与触发器的间距。
spacing.en-US: Gap between the dropdown layer and the trigger.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启下拉层的动画。

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉层溢出视口时是否自动调整方位。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown layer flips automatically when it overflows the viewport.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉层内的点击事件冒泡到外层。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether clicks inside the dropdown layer are stopped from bubbling out.

virtualize.zh-CN: 开启列表虚拟化，`itemSize` 必传。开启后不渲染分组标题与 `role="group"`，选项按顺序平铺。
virtualize.en-US: Turns on list virtualization; `itemSize` is required. Group titles and `role="group"` are not rendered with it, and the options are laid out flat in order.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动到元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing stops the browser from scrolling the element into view.

id.zh-CN: 触发器的 id，选项的 id 由它派生。
id.en-US: id of the trigger; the option ids derive from it.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中值变化时的回调，入参为新的值（开启 `onChangeWithObject` 时为选项对象）。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the new value (option objects with `onChangeWithObject`).

onDropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉列表展开或收起时的回调。
onDropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the dropdown list opens or closes.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索关键字变化时的回调；经 `search()` 或 `trigger` snippet 的 `onSearch` 触发时没有事件参数。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the search keyword changes; there is no event when it comes from `search()` or the `onSearch` of the `trigger` snippet.

onSelect.zh-CN: 选中某个选项时的回调。
onSelect.en-US: Called when an option is selected.

onDeselect.zh-CN: 多选时取消选中某个选项的回调。
onDeselect.en-US: Called when an option is deselected in multiple mode.

onExceed.zh-CN: 选中数量超过 `max` 时的回调。
onExceed.en-US: Called when the selection would exceed `max`.

onCreate.en-US: Called when an option is created.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入 Select 时触发一次。
onFocus.en-US: Called once when the focus enters the Select.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开 Select 时触发一次；点击打开的下拉层之外时传入其 mousedown 事件。
onBlur.en-US: Called once when the focus leaves the Select; a press outside the open dropdown passes its mousedown event.

onListScroll.zh-CN: 下拉列表滚动时的回调。
onListScroll.en-US: Called when the dropdown list scrolls.

prefix.zh-CN: 选择框前缀，snippet。内容为文本或 Icon 时自动带上左右间隔。
prefix.en-US: Prefix of the selection box, a snippet. The side padding is added when the content is text or an Icon.

suffix.zh-CN: 选择框后缀，snippet。内容为文本或 Icon 时自动带上左右间隔。
suffix.en-US: Suffix of the selection box, a snippet. The side padding is added when the content is text or an Icon.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，snippet。没有 `prefix` 时渲染，并作为 combobox 的名称来源。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label, a snippet. Rendered without a `prefix`, and the name source of the combobox.

clearIcon.en-US: Custom clear button icon, a snippet.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有选项时的内容，snippet；传 `null` 隐藏空状态。
emptyContent.en-US: Content when there are no options, a snippet; `null` hides the empty state.

outerTopSlot.zh-CN: 下拉层顶部与选项列表平级的内容，snippet，列表滚动时始终展现。
outerTopSlot.en-US: Content at the top of the dropdown layer, level with the option list, a snippet; always visible while the list scrolls.

innerTopSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在选项列表内部顶部的内容，snippet，滚动到顶部时展现。
innerTopSlot.en-US: Content inside the top of the option list, a snippet; visible when the list is scrolled to the top.

outerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 下拉层底部与选项列表平级的内容，snippet，列表滚动时始终展现。
outerBottomSlot.en-US: Content at the bottom of the dropdown layer, level with the option list, a snippet; always visible while the list scrolls.

innerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在选项列表内部底部的内容，snippet，滚动到底部时展现。
innerBottomSlot.en-US: Content inside the bottom of the option list, a snippet; visible when the list is scrolled to the bottom.

optionItem.zh-CN: 替换整个选项行，snippet，参数含 `id`、`value`、`label`、`selected`、`focused`、`disabled`、`inputValue`、`class`、`style`、`onclick`、`onmouseenter` 以及条目上的其他字段。`id` 要与 `role="option"` 一起写在选项元素上。
optionItem.en-US: Replaces a whole option row, a snippet. Its parameter has `id`, `value`, `label`, `selected`, `focused`, `disabled`, `inputValue`, `class`, `style`, `onclick`, `onmouseenter` and the other fields of the entry. Put `id` on the element with `role="option"`.

optionLabel.zh-CN: 只替换选项行里的文字，snippet，参数为 `{ option }`。选中图标、行的 `role="option"`、状态与键盘行为不变；`label` 仍用于搜索与可访问名称，内容里不高亮搜索关键字。
optionLabel.en-US: Replaces only the text inside an option row, a snippet with `{ option }`. The tick icon, the `role="option"` of the row, its states and keyboard behavior stay; `label` still serves search and the accessible name, and the search keyword is not highlighted in the content.

groupLabel.zh-CN: 替换分组标题的内容，snippet，参数为 `{ group }`（含 `key`、`label`）；不传时显示 `group.label`。
groupLabel.en-US: Replaces the content of a group title, a snippet with `{ group }` (`key` and `label`); without it `group.label` is shown.

createItem.zh-CN: 创建选项那一行的内容，snippet，参数为 `{ inputValue, focus, style }`；虚拟化时要把 `style` 用在自定义元素上。
createItem.en-US: Content of the row that creates an option, a snippet with `{ inputValue, focus, style }`; with virtualization apply `style` to the custom element.

selectedItem.zh-CN: 已选内容，snippet，参数为 `{ option, index, disabled, onClose }`。单选时替换选择框内容，多选时替换每个标签里的内容。
selectedItem.en-US: The selected content, a snippet with `{ option, index, disabled, onClose }`. In single mode it replaces the selection box content, in multiple mode the content of each tag.

tag.zh-CN: 多选时替换每个标签，snippet，参数同 `selectedItem`，同时提供时优先于 `selectedItem`。
tag.en-US: Replaces each tag in multiple mode, a snippet with the parameters of `selectedItem`; it takes precedence over `selectedItem`.

trigger.zh-CN: 替换触发器的内容，snippet，参数为 `{ value, inputValue, placeholder, disabled, onSearch, onClear, onRemove }`。
trigger.en-US: Replaces the trigger content, a snippet with `{ value, inputValue, placeholder, disabled, onSearch, onClear, onRemove }`.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦触发器，可搜索时聚焦搜索框并展开下拉列表。
focus.en-US: Focuses the trigger, or the search input with the dropdown list opened when searchable.

clearInput.en-US: Clears the value of the search input.

selectAll.zh-CN: 选中所有可见且未禁用的选项，仅多选时有效。
selectAll.en-US: Selects every shown, enabled option; multiple mode only.

search.en-US: Searches as if the keyword were typed into the search input.

rePosition.zh-CN: 按触发器当前位置立即重新计算下拉层位置，一般无需调用。
rePosition.en-US: Recomputes the dropdown position from the trigger's current position at once; rarely needed.
